title: कांग्रेस बैठक- गुटबन्दीलाई पूर्णतः निस्तेजदेखि बाटो बिराएकालाई फर्काउन पहल गर्नसम्मको माग
content:
No ads found for this position काठमाडौँ । नेपाली कांग्रेसका केन्द्रीय सदस्य निलकण्ठ रिजालले पार्टीको कार्यक्रम र गतिविधिहरू भाषण, बोली, नीति र सिद्धान्तमा मात्र नभई व्यवहारमा पनि स्पष्ट देखिनुपर्ने बताएका छन् । सानेपामा जारी केन्द्रीय समिति बैठकमा बोल्दै उनले यस्तो माग राखेका हुन् । उनले नेविसंघ, नेपाल तरुण दल, नेपाल दलित सङ्घ लगायतको कार्य समितिलाई छिटै पूर्णता दिई नेपाल महिला सङ्घ समेतका अन्य भातृ संस्थाहरूको लागि स्पष्ट समय सीमा तोकेर शीघ्र महाधिवेशनको लागि निर्देशन दिनुपर्ने, जिल्ला र प्रदेश अधिवेशनका मिति अविलम्ब तोकिनुपर्ने पनि बताए । उनले भने, ‘पार्टीमा जिम्मेवारी दिँदा अथवा निर्वाचनमा टिकट वितरण गर्दा आर्थिक हैसियत अनुसार उम्मेदवार छान्न खोज्ने प्रवृत्तिलाई निरुत्साहित गर्दै सामान्य आर्थिक हैसियत भएकाहरूले पनि कांग्रेस राजनीतिमा आफूलाई स्थापित गर्न सक्ने वातावरणको कांग्रेस बन्नुपर्छ।’ पार्टीको आन्तरिक निर्वाचनहरूमा उपविजेता भएका र पार्टीमा लामो समयदेखि सक्रिय रहँदै आएका तर प्राविधिक कारणवश हाल पार्टीमा जिम्मेवारी नपाएकालाई पनि जिम्मेवारी दिनुपर्ने बताए । उनले थपे, ‘साथै बाटो बिराएर अन्यत्र हिँडेका साथीहरूलाई पार्टीको मूलधारमा ल्याउन पूर्वाग्रह रहित ढङ्गले विशेष पहल गर्नुपर्दछ। पार्टीका वडा, पालिका, क्षेत्र, जिल्ला, प्रदेश, केन्द्र तहलगायतका निकायहरूमा पार्टी कमजोर बनाउने चरम गुटबन्दीलाई पूर्णतः निस्तेज गराउन केन्द्रबाटनै आवश्यक र इमानदार कदम चाल्नुपर्छ ।’ पार्टीमा दुख गरेका क्षमतावान् नेता कार्यकर्तालाई पार्टीबाट अवसर र जिम्मेवारी दिँदा न्याय र विवेकपूर्ण निर्णय हुन्छ भने विश्वास पार्टीका तल्लो निकाय सम्म दिलाउन सक्नुपर्ने समेत बताए । आगामी स्थानीय निर्वाचनमा केन्द्रबाट टिकट वितरण हुने परम्पराको अन्त्य गर्दै, स्पष्ट र पारदर्शी छनौट विधि बनाएर पार्टीका स्थानीय तहका ग्रास रुटका साथीहरू माझबाटै उम्मेदवार छनौट हुने व्यवस्था गर्नुपर्ने बताए । Kathmandu. Nepali Congress central committee member Nilakantha Rijal has said that the party's programs and activities should be clear not only in speeches, language, policies and principles but also in practice. He made this demand while speaking at the ongoing central committee meeting in Sanepa. He also said that the working committees of the Nepali Congress, Nepal Tarun Dal, Nepal Dalit Association and others should be completed soon, and that clear deadlines should be set for other sister organizations including the Nepal Women's Association and instructions should be given for an early general convention, and that the dates for district and provincial conventions should be fixed without delay. He said, "The Congress should create an environment where even those with average economic status can establish themselves in politics, discouraging the tendency to select candidates based on economic status when assigning responsibilities in the party or distributing tickets in elections." He said that those who were runners-up in the party's internal elections and have been active in the party for a long time but have not received responsibilities in the party due to technical reasons should also be given responsibilities. He added, "Also, special initiatives should be taken to bring comrades who have strayed and gone elsewhere into the mainstream of the party without prejudice. Necessary and honest steps should be taken from the center itself to completely eliminate the extreme factionalism that is weakening the party in the party's wards, municipalities, regions, districts, provinces, and central levels." He also said that if the party gives opportunities and responsibilities to capable leaders and cadres who have suffered in the party, then justice and prudent decisions will be made and trust should be instilled even in the lower levels of the party. He said that in the upcoming local elections, the tradition of distributing tickets from the center should be ended and a clear and transparent selection method should be established to select candidates from among the party's grassroots friends at the local level.

Nepali Congress central committee member Nilakantha Rijal has said that the party's programs and activities should be clear not only in speeches, language, policies and principles but also in practice. He made this demand while speaking at the ongoing central committee meeting in Sanepa. He also said that the working committees of the Nepali Congress, Nepal Tarun Dal, Nepal Dalit Association and others should be completed soon, and that clear deadlines should be set for other sister organizations including the Nepal Women's Association and instructions should be given for an early general convention, and that the dates for district and provincial conventions should be fixed without delay. He said, "The Congress should create an environment where even those with average economic status can establish themselves in politics, discouraging the tendency to select candidates based on economic status when assigning responsibilities in the party or distributing tickets in elections." He said that those who were runners-up in the party's internal elections and have been active in the party for a long time but have not received responsibilities in the party due to technical reasons should also be given responsibilities. He added, "Also, special initiatives should be taken to bring comrades who have strayed and gone elsewhere into the mainstream of the party without prejudice. Necessary and honest steps should be taken from the center itself to completely eliminate the extreme factionalism that is weakening the party in the party's wards, municipalities, regions, districts, provinces, and central levels." He also said that if the party gives opportunities and responsibilities to capable leaders and cadres who have suffered in the party, then justice and prudent decisions will be made and trust should be instilled even in the lower levels of the party. He said that in the upcoming local elections, the tradition of distributing tickets from the center should be ended and a clear and transparent selection method should be established to select candidates from among the party's grassroots friends at the local level.
